commitments.description: Make all packaging reusable, recyclable, or compostable by 2025; cut virgin plastic 25% by 2025.
Invest US$1 billion through 2030 in sustainability initiatives including packaging redesign.

controversies.description: Wrappers from M&M's, Snickers, and Twix consistently appear on beach-audit top-10 lists.

wooby.headline: Mars makes Snickers and M&Ms — and is trying paper wrappers.
wooby.narrative: Mars makes Snickers, M&M's, Twix, and pet food too. They are testing paper wrappers for some chocolate bars. Wooby thinks paper is much friendlier to fish and turtles than plastic.
